entries.core_move: Express a periodic continuous-time signal in trigonometric Fourier series form by organizing its DC term and sine and cosine harmonics at integer multiples of the fundamental angular frequency.
Compute the cosine coefficients $a_k$ by integrating a periodic continuous-time signal against each cosine harmonic over one period to measure its contribution to the trigonometric Fourier series.
Compute the sine coefficients $b_k$ by integrating a periodic continuous-time signal against each sine harmonic over one period to measure its contribution to the trigonometric Fourier series.
Interpret $a_0$, $a_k$, and $b_k$ as the DC level and signed cosine and sine harmonic weights that describe the frequency-domain content of a periodic continuous-time signal.
Interpret each positive integer harmonic index $k$ as the label that pairs $a_k$ and $b_k$ with the $k$th harmonic frequency $k\omega_0$ in a trigonometric Fourier series.

entries.lesson_title: Reconstructing a Periodic Signal from Harmonics
entries.core_move: Assemble a periodic signal by summing its DC term with sine and cosine harmonics indexed by $k$ using the fundamental angular frequency and the given trigonometric Fourier coefficients.
